# grid.Body's scrollEdge carries the store's total; a hidden-only append does not re-arm it

## Context

#19356 / PR #19357 (merged 2026-10-02) gave `Neo.grid.Body` the `scrollEdge` event: once per entry into the store's last `bufferRowRange` rows, re-armed by a change of the store's count. Its first consumer, the Fleet Manager's operator mailbox (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#416 / PR #420), hides collapsed thread members with a store filter, and Sophie's review of that PR asked what happens when fifty replies land under one collapsed head: the store's **total** moves, its visible `count` does not, and the edge does not announce again.

## The Problem

Not the latch: the event. The visible count is the right key for both the predicate and the re-arm — nothing the viewport can reach moved, so a hidden-only append is correctly quiet, and continuation into hidden rows is the consumer's deliberate act (expanding the thread), after which the visible change re-arms as usual. What the consumer lacked was the store's **total** beside the count, to tell "the corpus is complete" from "the rest is behind a filter", and the contract never said that a hidden-only append stays quiet by design.

History, kept as history: a `visible/total` re-arm key was tried in the consumer's interim body and withdrawn on the same day — it re-announced on every hidden-only append and walked a collapsed inbox window by window with no gesture, the boot drain under another projection (Sophie, Institution #420, R1 → final).

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/Body.mjs` `updateMountedAndVisibleRows`: `countRecords = store.count`; `#scrollEdgeAnnouncedFor` holds the count the edge was announced for; the predicate `endIndex + bufferRowRange >= countRecords`.
- `Neo.data.Store` exposes the unfiltered items as `allItems` (`store.allItems.getCount()`), the filtered ones as `items` / `count`.
- `test/playwright/unit/grid/BodyScrollEdge.spec.mjs` pins enter / stay / grow / shrink / short / empty over an unfiltered store; no filtered store was in the file before this leaf.

## The Fix

The latch stays keyed on the **visible count**; the event gains `total` (`store.allItems.getCount()` behind a filter, the count otherwise) beside `count` as information; the `@event` block and the grid guide say why a hidden-only append does not announce again. One new arm: a one-row filtered store; append ten hidden items and re-filter; two layouts stay quiet; drop the filter and scroll: the visible change announces with the total.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrollEdge` on `Neo.grid.Body` | `src/grid/Body.mjs` | `{count, endIndex, startIndex, total}` once per entry; re-armed only when the visible `count` changes; a hidden-only append stays quiet. | unchanged | the `@event` block, `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` | `BodyScrollEdge.spec.mjs`: the existing six arms + the hidden-append arm |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The event carries `total` beside `count` (red-first: the committed payload has no `total`).
- [x] Appending items a store filter hides while the viewport stays at the edge announces nothing on further layouts; dropping the filter and scrolling announces again with the total beside the count.
- [x] The existing enter / stay / grow / shrink / short / empty arms stay green.
- [x] The event doc and the guide name the total and the hidden-append rule.

Delivered by PR #19360 (merged 2026-10-02, f933877).

## Out of Scope

- The predicate itself (the visible count stays the measure of the viewport's reach).
- The Institution consumers (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#429 retires the interim subclass once a pin carries this; the retirement landed with neomjs/neo-agent-institution#433).
